initialDirectAdapterRun.mode: Three small real provider inference requests using supplied credentials. Direct adapter smoke only: no production Firebase session/Firestore, deployed rules, genuine Google consent or live publication is proven. Uses existing quota; no paid plan, upgrade or purchase was performed.

liveProviderProbes.interpretation: Real Gemini Pin and Cloudflare FLUX.2 featured-image adapter requests passed. The first one-model Groq article request was not accepted by the bounded adapter; its exact response failure was not captured. A separate Groq request then passed complete article validation. Earlier FLUX.1 live inference is recorded separately. These are bounded availability snapshots, not a reliability guarantee. Automatic failure/quota routing is deliberately tested with doubles, not induced live outages. No production Firebase session, owner usage transaction, genuine Google consent or publication was tested by these direct probes.

limitations: Vercel project environment was confirmed empty before this release. Production Admin authorization and owner Console work remain necessary; env import has not been performed by the agent.
No real Firebase Authentication provider enablement, production verification/reset email delivery or Google consent has been performed.
Firestore production rules/indexes/IAM have not been deployed or checked. The emulator does not enforce production composite-index readiness.
No Functions/Scheduler deployment, scheduled delivery, provider publishing consent, live Pin/Blog publication, paid upgrade or billing activation occurred.
AI artwork is downloadable only, not saved to Firestore/Library, publicly hosted or automatically scheduled. Worker images remain signed server-rendered PNG title cards.
Model fallback cannot bypass a Cloudflare-wide outage or account quota. Safety refusals stop failover. All providers can be exhausted; errors are explicit and do not substitute an offline template.
Reserved failures consume request caps. Caps bound request counts, not monetary charges. Provider quotas and billing are separate.
Text receipt replay expires logically after 24 hours. No Firestore TTL policy or automated deletion is enabled. Images and raw prompts are not persisted in AI receipts.
Native/emulator logs can contain a MetadataLookupWarning with HTTP 401 during credential metadata discovery; native checks pass, browser runtime/console errors remain empty.
